_meta.description: Part 1/3 friction themes the Category Nudge Agent matches against. Numbers are the real, locked Part 1 discovery-engine results (see docs/problem_statement.md and docs/architecture.md). NOT synthetic — these are the actual evidence counts.
_meta.source: docs/problem_statement.md sections 2 and 4; Part 1 Two-Step Gated extraction (1,094 gate-passing extractions)
_meta.scope_note: Only addresses the ~50% of category stagnation that is quality/trust-driven, not the low-intent half. Nudge must not overclaim.

themes.name: Poor Quality and Unreliable Products
themes.description: A quality/reliability failure (damaged, expired, or fake/duplicate item) generalizes into category-specific avoidance. The user withholds the benefit of the doubt from unfamiliar categories.

themes.name: Packaging / Fulfillment Failure
themes.description: Sub-theme distinct from product-source quality: fragile items arrive crushed because they were packed under heavier groceries. The product isn't defective at source; the fulfillment is.

themes.name: Low Intent (No Incident)
themes.description: A meaningful share of the stuck segment has had no bad experience at all - they simply have not been given a reason to try an unfamiliar category. Not a trust problem; a relevance/awareness problem.
themes.scope_note: The nudge mechanic (refund + quality signal) is NOT the primary lever for this group. Matching here should produce a softer, honestly-scoped nudge, not overclaim a trust fix.
